response:
I have resolved the issue causing 407 Proxy Authentication Required errors when using proxies with authentication.

### Root Cause
1. `prepend_scheme_if_needed` in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/utils.py) was updated to use `urllib3.util.parse_url`, which separates the authority into `auth` and `netloc`. Re-assembling `netloc` without `auth` stripped the username and password from proxy URLs processed by `prepend_scheme_if_needed`.
2. `get_auth_from_url` called `unquote(parsed.username)` and `unquote(parsed.password)` without checking for `None`. When either component was absent (e.g. `http://user@proxy:8080`), `unquote(None)` raised a `TypeError`, causing the exception handler to return `('', '')` and drop credentials.
3. `rebuild_proxies` in [`requests/sessions.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/sessions.py) looked up `new_proxies[scheme]` directly instead of using `select_proxy`, which caused key lookups to fail (raising `KeyError`) when proxy maps used keys like `'all'` or host-specific entries.

### Key Changes
- Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/utils.py#L960-L995) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/utils.py) to preserve `auth` in `netloc` when formatting URLs and accurately handle scheme-less proxy URLs.
- Updated [`get_auth_from_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/utils.py#L1000-L1015) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/utils.py) to run URLs through `prepend_scheme_if_needed` and safely unquote `username` and `password` only when present.
- Updated [`proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/adapters.py#L386-L394) in [`requests/adapters.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/adapters.py) and [`rebuild_proxies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/sessions.py#L284-L298) in [`requests/sessions.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-8dwqo80n/requests/sessions.py) to use `select_proxy` and generate `Proxy-Authorization` headers whenever `username` or `password` is present.
